cuts.case: legacy consumed failed root -> explicit sequence2
cuts.expect: one root lineage/index plus one next lineage/index, new Task/context/Plan/confirmation, same binding/Goal/profile, zero Run/effect/model/provider/verifier

cuts.case: same intent twice or lost response
cuts.expect: same prepared result exact hash and zero extra entities/indexes/confirmations

cuts.case: concurrent distinct intents targeting same prior head
cuts.expect: exactly one sequence2; other STALE_INPUT; no implicit sequence3

cuts.case: broken index hash/gap/predecessor/Artifact/plan/root or ambiguous legacy plans
two historical qualification grants and one ordinary mu_turn grant
cuts.expect: each validates own Task/Run/epoch and original plan/dispatch; no latest-task coupling; unrelated grant rejected
explicit checked attempt selection; no QueryRow(runtime) ambiguity, no old confirm redirect
same id/key/counts/body before/after; lineage absent from Task input refs
no new Task/index/consent; no reset/new IDs to evade; current execution gate also blocks

cuts.case: old consumed request after new attempt
cuts.expect: old CONFIRM addresses old request and refuses replay; STATUS retains old failure and UNKNOWN amount

cuts.case: plain FAILED without closure, unknown external effect, missing native proof
cuts.expect: not eligible for EXECUTION_FAILED_CLOSED or next preparation
legacy request serialization/hash exact; invalid/partial fresh binding rejected; expired fresh request never regenerated silently

cuts.case: Desktop restart / prepare timeout / context switch
cuts.expect: read-only validated history restores exact intent/result; no auto PREPARE_NEXT or CONFIRM; old history retained

cuts.case: normal GUI complete flow with fixture provider
cuts.expect: visible prior failure, explicit prepare-next zero calls, separate labeled one-call confirmation, exactly one fixture call and no tools

cuts.case: crash after each Task/context/Plan/Artifact/index/confirmation write before commit
cuts.expect: atomic rollback; no orphan attempt; retry same intent creates only one complete result

cuts.case: crash after commit before private reply
cuts.expect: history/idempotency returns committed exact request; no second preparation or execution
initial single-plan behavior remains; coding permissions/grants preserved
